issue_snapshot.body:
Deferred from #33 by its work order: activity-feed UTC-labelled timestamps visible behind the shell on /activity are outside landing/auth/shell/footer scope; their redesign belongs to the later activity slice.

## Acceptance (from the split)

- **IAC-1** No developer artefacts are linked or shown anywhere on landing, auth, shell, or footer: no /api/health link, no raw ids, no ISO dates, no UTC timestamps.

Part of #31.
Depends on #33.
